name: Total Transactions 6
definition: Set of elements used to provide summary information on entries.

TotalEntries.name: Total Entries
TotalEntries.definition: Specifies the total number and sum of debit and credit entries.

TotalCreditEntries.name: Total Credit Entries
TotalCreditEntries.definition: Specifies the total number and sum of credit entries.

TotalDebitEntries.name: Total Debit Entries
TotalDebitEntries.definition: Specifies the total number and sum of debit entries.

TotalEntriesPerBankTransactionCode.name: Total Entries Per Bank Transaction Code
TotalEntriesPerBankTransactionCode.definition: Specifies the total number and sum of entries per bank transaction code.
